abstract: A case of mediastinal mature teratoma with elevated serum CA19-9 level is reported. A 50-year-old woman admitted to our hospital complaining of cough and chest pain. Chest X-ray showed an abnormal mass shadow with retention of the right pleural effusion. Her serum CA19-9 level was high (204.4 U/ml), while serum AFP, CEA, HCG levels were normal. On lateral thoracotomy, an anterior mediastinal tumor perforating into the right lung was revealed and the total resection of the tumor with adherent part of the right lung was performed. Postoperatively, her serum CA19-9 level returned to normal. Histological examination disclosed a mature teratoma consisting of skin, pancreatic tissue, cartilage, bronchial epithelium, etc. Immunohistochemical staining were positive in the bronchial epithelium and bronchial gland but was negative in the pancreatic tissue of the tumor. This is a rare case of mediastinal mature teratoma with elevated serum CA19-9 level and negative immunohistochemical staining for it in the pancreatic tissue of the tumor.
abstract_ja: 50歳の女性が咳と胸痛を主訴に受診した。胸部X線写真で右胸水の貯留を伴う異常な陰影を認めた。血清CA19-9値は高値（204.4 U/ml）であったが、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CEA、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は正常であった。側方開胸術により、右肺に穿通する前縦隔腫瘍が認められ、癒着した右肺の一部を含めて腫瘍を全摘した。術後、血清CA19-9値は正常化した。組織学的検査で、皮膚、膵組織、軟骨、気管支上皮などからなる成熟奇形腫が明らかになった。免疫組織化学染色では、気管支上皮と気管支腺で陽性、腫瘍の膵組織では陰性であった。膵組織でCA19-9が陰性を示した、血清CA19-9高値を呈する縦隔成熟奇形腫のまれな症例である。
